title: Unreal Futures: Careers in Fashion
description: Go behind the scenes and see how interactive 3D is changing the fashion industry in 'Unreal Futures: Careers in Fashion,' featuring Burberry and the Fashion Innovation Agency. You’ll also be introduced to new and exciting careers in design, retail, and digital-only fashion that are being driven by interactive 3D. Finally, you’ll add to your digital portfolio by creating a dramatic interactive fashion experience of your own using Unreal Engine.
